title: Most learning apps keep kids
busy. Few actually teach them.
honest.body: Parents struggle to find digital experiences that are genuinely enriching. Most apps are either mind-numbing entertainment or rigorous, joyless testing. The result? Guilt-inducing screen time.
honest.cardBody: We bridge the gap. Kimee transforms essential developmental skills into a magical world of exploration. It’s screen time that parents trust and kids actually crave.

cards.title: Learning that feels like play
cards.body: Interactive quests and games disguised as fun, ensuring your child stays engaged while absorbing core concepts.

cards.title: AI that knows your child
cards.body: Kimee adapts to every answer. Pacing, hints, and challenges shift to match how your child actually learns.

cards.title: Clarity for parents
cards.body: A weekly snapshot of what your child explored, what clicked, and where they need a little help. No guesswork.

title: Sparky answers the questions
a report card never could.
sparky.body: Ask anything about your child’s progress — strengths, gaps, what to practice next. Sparky reads every lesson they’ve played and explains it in plain language, any time you ask.
sparky.alt: Sparky — the AI assistant that answers parents' questions

how.title: 10 minutes a day. Real progress in 30 days.

steps.title: AI builds plan
steps.body: A tailored weekly roadmap is generated based on current skill levels.

steps.title: Child explores
steps.body: 10-15 minutes of immersive, guided play across the learning islands.

steps.title: Parent sees results
steps.body: Receive a simple, clear update on what was learned and achieved.

faq.title: Answers, before you have to ask.

items.a: Yes. Kimee is designed for children aged 3–8. Every mini-game starts at the most basic level and adapts to your child's ability, so preschoolers can play without needing to read first.

items.q: Are there ads in the app?
items.a: None at all. No ads, no in-game purchases, and no links out of the app — including on the free plan.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a: You can cancel anytime from your account settings, no need to contact us. Access stays active until the paid period ends, and your child's learning progress is never lost.

s1.title: Introduction
s1.body: Kimee is committed to protecting the privacy of children and families. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect information from our educational platform. We comply with COPPA and GDPR child data protection standards.

s2.title: Information We Collect
s2.parents: Name, email, password (encrypted), payment details (Bank Transfer, Credit Card, E-wallet, QRIS)
s2.children: First name, age, avatar, learning interests, progress scores, activity history, Sparky AI chat interactions
s2.technical: Device type, browser, session duration (for platform functionality)

s3.title: How We Use Information
s3.personalization: Create Daily Path learning activities and 7-Day Roadmap based on child's age and interests
s3.progress: Monitor achievements across Island Map areas (Math & Logic, Literacy, Creativity, SEL, Life Skills)
s3.ai: Power Sparky assistant recommendations and learning analytics
s3.account: Process subscriptions, manage multiple child profiles (Premium plans)

s4.title: Information Sharing
s4.warning: We NEVER sell or rent your child's information.
s4.body: Limited sharing only with: Payment processors (secure transactions), hosting providers (data storage), legal requirements (when required by law)

s5.title: Data Security
s5.body: All data encrypted (AES-256), secure authentication, regular security audits, 24/7 monitoring

s6.title: Your Rights
s6.parents: View all child data, download data (JSON format), request deletion (processed within 30 days), modify information, withdraw consent anytime
s6.access: Settings → Data Privacy or contact privacy@Kidemy.com

s7.title: Data Retention
s7.body: Active accounts: Data retained while active • Deleted accounts: Permanently deleted within 30 days • Backups: Removed within 90 days

s8.title: Children's Privacy (Ages 3-12)
s8.body: Age gate verification required • Parental consent before any data collection • No public forums or social features • Parent can review and delete child data anytime • No collection beyond what's necessary for learning

s9.title: Updates
s9.body: Policy changes communicated via email with updated date. Continued use after changes means acceptance.

termsConditions.title: Terms & Conditions

s1.title: Agreement
s1.body: By creating an account, you agree to these Terms. Must be 18+ and a parent/guardian. Kimee is for children ages 3-12. These Terms are legally binding.

s2.title: Your Account
s2.resp: Provide accurate information • Keep password and PIN secure • Notify us of unauthorized access • Don't share credentials outside household • Supervise your child's use

s3.title: What Kimee Provides
s3.list:
• Island Map Learning: 5 educational areas (Jungle Adventure for Math & Logic, Storybook Land for Literacy, Artful Archipelago for Creativity, Empathy Bay for SEL, Discovery Cove for Life Skills)
• Personalized Features: Daily Path learning activities, 7-Day Roadmap, Sparky AI assistant
• Progress Tracking: Achievement scores, learning analytics, detailed reports
• Parent Tools: Settings dashboard, multiple child profiles (Premium), PIN protection
s3.note: We may modify features anytime. Service provided "as is" without guarantees of specific learning outcomes.

s4.title: Information Sharing
s4.warning: We NEVER sell or rent your child's information.
s4.body: Limited sharing only with: Payment processors (secure transactions), hosting providers (data storage), legal requirements (when required by law)

s5.title: Subscription Plans
s5.free: 1 child profile, basic Island Map access
s5.includes: Premium includes: Multiple children, Daily Path, advanced activities, full progress reports
s5.payment: Payment: Bank Transfer, Credit Card, E-wallet, QRIS • Auto-renewal unless canceled • Cancel via Settings → Subscription → Manage Plan • Access continues until period ends • No refunds for partial periods • 7-day free trial for new Premium users

s6.title: Acceptable Use
s6.dont: Share account outside household • Bypass security • Reverse engineer • Use bots or scrapers • Upload malicious content • Provide false information • Use for commercial purposes

s7.title: Ownership
s7.content: All games, Island Map, Sparky character, graphics, and software owned by Kimee (copyright protected) • You get personal, non-commercial use license only
s7.data: Profile and progress data remains yours • We use it only as described in Privacy Policy

s8.title: Privacy
s8.intro: See our Privacy Policy for full details.
s8.key: We never sell child data • Parental consent required • Access child data via Settings → Data Privacy • Delete data anytime (30-day processing) • COPPA & GDPR compliant

s9.title: Disclaimers
s9.body: Service provided "AS IS" without guarantees • No warranty of uninterrupted service • No guarantee of specific learning outcomes • We strive for quality but content may have errors

s10.title: Liability Limits
s10.body: Kimee not liable for: Indirect damages, data loss, service interruptions, unauthorized account access • Maximum liability limited to amount paid in past 12 months

s11.title: Account Termination
s11.you: Delete account anytime via Settings → Security → Delete Account (data deleted in 30 days)
s11.we: Suspend/terminate for Terms violations, fraud, abuse, or non-payment (notice when possible)

s12.title: Changes & Updates
s12.body: We may update Terms anytime • Changes notified via email • Continued use = acceptance • If you disagree, delete account

termsConditions.footer: By creating an account, you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy.
